recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, atmospheric composition featuring a central rectangular photographic window set against a solid black frame, topped with high-contrast serif typography and a large, semi-transparent ampersand.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast silhouette against a luminous nocturnal sky
Typographic header integrated with a large graphic symbol
Rectangular image inset within a larger dark field
coreInvariants: Central bright light source with radial flare

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A mountain ridge silhouette occupies the lower right third of the inner frame; a bright starburst is centered in the upper half of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white starburst/sun against the dark blue sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright light, move down to the silhouetted figures on the ridge, then upward to the bold white title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive solid black framing around the central image and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Solid black for the frame and silhouettes.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep midnight blue for the sky gradients.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the light source and primary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value contrast between the bright light source and the surrounding darkness.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is scaled to roughly 150% of the capital letter height and rendered in a semi-transparent grey.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with a contrasting weight/style for the graphic ampersand.
graphicDevices: Large decorative ampersand as a background element for text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classical serif proportions and sharp terminals.
Provides the necessary high contrast between thick and thin strokes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark blue monochromatic photograph of a mountain ridge silhouette at night. A single bright starburst light source should be in the upper center sky. Place this image inside a horizontal rectangular window centered on a solid black square background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two words in all-caps white serif font at the top. Between the words, place a large, light-grey italicized ampersand that is taller than the letters and sits slightly behind them.

verificationChecks: Is the sky a deep blue gradient?
Is the ampersand significantly larger than the surrounding text?
Is the main text pure white and all-caps?
Is there a thick black border around the entire composition?

adjustableVariables: Width of the black outer frame
Specific silhouette shapes on the ridge
mustRedesign: Do not replicate exact human silhouettes from the original
Ensure the text content is generic or user-defined

mustAchieve: Smooth blue-to-black gradients in the sky

postGenerationChecks: The image window is a horizontal rectangle.
The text is positioned in the upper black margin.
The ampersand is grey and larger than the white letters.
The overall mood is nocturnal and contemplative.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic night photo + centered rectangular inset + high-contrast serif header + oversized graphic symbol overlay.
